# feelzlike

> feelzlike shows live weather, road conditions, lift status, and travel info for resort towns across Australia, New Zealand, Japan, Canada, and the United States. It is towns-first: the experience centres on the base towns people actually stay in (Jindabyne, Bright, Yudanaka, etc.) rather than the ski resorts on the mountain above.

## Public landing pages

- [Home](https://feelzlike.com/): intro, region picker, and near-you shortcut
- [Browse by country](https://feelzlike.com/countries): choose Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Canada, or the United States
- [Australia](https://feelzlike.com/au): all Australian resort regions
- [Japan](https://feelzlike.com/jp): all Japanese resort regions
- [New Zealand](https://feelzlike.com/nz): all New Zealand resort regions
- [Canada](https://feelzlike.com/ca): all Canadian resort regions (BC, Alberta + Québec)
- [United States](https://feelzlike.com/us): all US resort regions (Colorado, Utah, California, Vermont, Wyoming, Montana, New Mexico)
- [Near you](https://feelzlike.com/near-you): weather and radar for your current location
- [News](https://feelzlike.com/news): resort-town news and weather updates
- [Trip planner](https://feelzlike.com/plan): multi-day trip planning across regions

## Resort regions

- [Snowy Mountains (NSW, AU)](https://feelzlike.com/snowy-mountains): Jindabyne, Berridale, Cooma · Perisher, Thredbo, Selwyn, Charlotte's Pass
- [Victoria's High Country (VIC, AU)](https://feelzlike.com/victorias-high-country): Mansfield, Bright, Mount Beauty, Harrietville, Dinner Plain, Marysville, Warburton, Omeo
- [Yamanouchi (Nagano, JP)](https://feelzlike.com/yamanouchi): Yudanaka, Shibu Onsen, Yomase · Shiga Kogen
- [Summit County (CO, US)](https://feelzlike.com/summit-county): Breckenridge, Keystone, Copper Mountain, Georgetown · Breckenridge, Keystone, Copper Mountain, Arapahoe Basin, Loveland

## Region features

Each region exposes: weather (mountains), alerts, stay, eat, and explore sub-sections reachable at /:region/mountains, /:region/alerts, /:region/stay, /:region/eat, and /:region/explore.

## Town pages

Each base town exposes: weather forecast, stay, eat, roads (with road cams), transport, and explore, reachable at /:region/:town/:section.

Example: https://feelzlike.com/snowy-mountains/jindabyne/weather
